description_excerpt: Job Description We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Electronic Hardware Engineering Manager / Technical Lead to lead our hardware design team. In this role, you will drive the architecture, development, integration, and validation of next-generation high-performance electronic hardware platforms for automotive applications, particularly ADAS and infotainment systems. The ideal candidate has extensive experience in high-speed board-level design, analytical engineering, simulation, and technical leadership. You will lead and develop a team of hardware design and PCB layout engineers…
